description: Our innovative platform leverages the power of Next.js and Tailwind CSS to offer a seamless user experience for generating and minting custom NFTs. Utilizing OpenAI's latest model, users can input their unique prompts to create high-quality, precise images. These images can then be minted as NFTs with ease, thanks to our integration with Starknet L2 and Dynamic for wallet connectivity. By paying a nominal fee of 4 STRK per NFT, users can secure their custom digital assets on the blockchain, ensuring ownership and provenance. Our system ensures a smooth and efficient process, allowing users to engage with cutting-edge AI technology and blockchain in one unified platform.
how_its_made:
Technologies Used:
1. Next.js: This React-based framework was chosen for its ability to create a fast, SEO-friendly web application with ease. It handles server-side rendering and static site generation, which are essential for a smooth user experience.
2. Tailwind CSS: This utility-first CSS framework allowed for rapid and customizable UI development. Its responsive design features ensured that the application looks great on all devices.
3. OpenAI: We integrated OpenAI’s latest model to handle the image generation from user prompts. This choice provided us with the capability to produce high-quality and accurate images, enhancing user satisfaction.
4. Starknet : Starknet, a Layer 2 solution on Ethereum, was employed for NFT minting. This provided scalability and reduced transaction costs, making the minting process more efficient and cost-effective for users.
5. Cairo: The Cairo programming language was used to develop and deploy smart contracts on Starknet. Its efficiency and capability in handling complex computations were crucial for the NFT minting process.
